title: CONNECT-UDP Conversion Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 stream-reference interpretation and UDP packet to HTTP Datagram conversion policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpConversionPolicy` maps stream references to the entire connection for HTTP versions without stream multiplexing, encodes UDP packet payloads as RFC 9298 Section 5 Context ID zero HTTP Datagrams, decodes received HTTP Datagrams back to UDP packet payloads, rejects non-UDP Context IDs for packet conversion, and stops conversion after tunnel closure.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper owns byte-format conversion and tunnel-open gating but does not schedule network I/O.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Context IDs other than zero are not converted to UDP packets by this helper.
Closed tunnels reject both UDP-to-HTTP-Datagram and HTTP-Datagram-to-UDP conversion.
Stream reference scope is selected from HTTP version multiplexing capability.
risks: Adapter code still needs end-to-end packet-loop integration.
Performance proof remains a ProtocolLab follow-up.
